opportunities.name: KAYAK hotel stay search with guests and filters
opportunities.description: On KAYAK Stays, search hotels for a {destination}, {check-in}/{check-out} dates and {rooms}/{adults}/{children}, then apply filters such as hotel class, review score or amenities, and sort the results by price or distance.
steps: Click Stays in the left nav
Type the destination and pick the matching suggestion
Open the check-in calendar and pick the check-in and check-out dates
Open the guests popover and set rooms, adults, children and each child's age
Click the search button
On the results page, apply filters (hotel class, review score, amenities, style)
Open the sort dropdown and choose a sort order (e.g. Price low to high)

instances.values: Le Marais, Paris; Mar 27 - Apr 2; 2 rooms, 3 adults; sort by price low to high
Santa Fe, NM; Jun 16 - Jun 18; 2 rooms, 3 adults
Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Varanasi; Jun 6 - Jun 10; 2 rooms, 3 adults + 1 child (age 7); review 8+, 3-star, free internet, family style, air-conditioned; sort by price low to high
Los Angeles, CA; May 21 - May 23; 1 room, 2 adults; 5-star filter

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways flight search and fare selection
opportunities.description: On qatarairways.com, search one-way flights (regular or Qatar Stopover) from {origin} to {destination} on {date} for {passengers} in {cabin class}, then pick a flight and select a fare.
steps: Open the Book widget and choose the Flights or Qatar Stopover tab
Type the origin airport and pick the suggestion
Type the destination airport and pick the suggestion
Set the trip type to one way
Open the depart calendar, pick the date and click Continue
Open Passengers/Class and set adults, children, infants and the cabin class, then click Confirm
Click Show flights
Pick the flight's fare-class box (Economy/Business)
Click Select fare on the fare family you want (for return/stopover legs too)

instances.values: Stopover, Colombo CMB -> New York JFK, one way, 24 Jun 23, 2 adults + 1 child, Premium/Business; Business Comfort fare
Doha DOH -> Durban DUR, one way, 28 May 23, 2 adults + 1 infant, Economy; Economy Comfort fare

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways hotel search via the Booking.com partner site
opportunities.description: From the Qatar Airways Book > Hotels menu, search the Booking.com partner site for {destination}, {dates} and {guests/rooms}, then sort or filter the results and open a property.
steps: On qatarairways.com, open the Book menu and click Hotels
On the partner Booking.com page, type the destination and pick the suggestion
Open the date picker, pick check-in and check-out dates
Click Search
In the results sidebar, set adults, children and rooms, then click Done
Apply filters (neighbourhood, facilities, star rating) or choose a sort order
Click See availability on the hotel you want and then Reserve

instances.values: Las Vegas, NV; Apr 10 - Apr 16; 2 adults, 1 room; sort by price (lowest first)
Washington, DC; Jun 5 - Jun 6; 4 adults, 2 rooms; Downtown DC, Free WiFi, 5 stars; St. Regis, Reserve
